sources.publisher: Italian Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MAECI): call for 2026-27 scholarships, copy on the Italian Cultural Institute Madrid site
sources.note: Names the course types funded, the institution types that may host a scholar, the age limits and the classes preferred for the Attanasio awards; it names no individual university or AFAM institution
Where applications are made; points to Universitaly for course and institution search and carries no list of institutions

subject_rule: No subject list: the scholar chooses a course at an Italian state or legally recognised non-state institution. What is funded is limited by course type: master's (second cycle), AFAM first and second cycle, PhD, research projects and a short Italian language course. Bachelor's (except AFAM), single-cycle master's, university master's of level I and II, specialisation courses, one-year courses and single courses are excluded.

programmes.name: AFAM first-cycle courses (art, music, dance)
programmes.detail: 9-month award, 1 November 2026 to 31 July 2027, renewable; the only first-cycle courses open to new awardees; applicants up to 28 years old; the institution sets its own entry requirements

programmes.name: Laurea magistrale (second-cycle degree), any subject
programmes.detail: 9-month award, renewable; needs a first-cycle degree; Italian-taught courses need B2 Italian, English-taught courses need B2 English; applicants up to 28 years old

programmes.name: AFAM second-cycle courses (art, music, dance)
programmes.detail: 9-month award, renewable; applicants up to 28 years old

programmes.name: International relations, development cooperation, humanitarian law and human rights (Attanasio awards)
programmes.detail: 3 reserved awards for candidates from Morocco, Nigeria and the Democratic Republic of the Congo; preferred classes LM-38, LM-52, LM-62, LM-81 and LM-87

programmes.name: PhD (dottorato di ricerca), any subject
programmes.detail: 9-month award, renewable; needs the institution's admission letter and a passed entrance test; applicants up to 30 years old; no language certificate needed

programmes.name: Italofonia: intensive Italian language and culture course
programmes.detail: 3-month award (3,600 euros in one payment) for applicants with at least A2 Italian; applicants up to 28 years old; tuition and school fees are not waived

notes: The call does not list eligible institutions: it says only that the course must be at an Italian state or legally recognised non-state institution, in person in Italy, and sends applicants to Universitaly to look up courses and admission tests.

Research-project awards (9 months, not renewable, applicants up to 40) can be held at state or recognised non-state universities, public research bodies, museums and archives; they need a host tutor's invitation and a research plan.
The scholarship is chosen by citizenship; the eligible-country list is on the Study in Italy portal.
not_stated: List of eligible universities and AFAM institutions
fetch_problems: The Study in Italy portal shows no institution list; no partner list was found on any other page reached
